title: WordPress creates no revision when a post is only published, so revisions cannot show who published it
symptoms: Only the creation revision exists on a post someone later published
cause: A status-only transition, such as clicking Publish without editing, does not add a revision.
fix: Use an audit log plugin or compare post_modified with post_date_gmt; do not infer from revisions who changed a status.
apply: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts/<id>?context=edit and compare modified_gmt with date_gmt
